clips.title: The story
paras: At Iceflow Lake, dwarves keep fishing holes open through the ice. The lake lies in western Dun Morogh, directly north of Brewnall Village. Snow-covered islands rise from its center, where winter wolves and their alpha, Timber, prowl.

Iceflow Lake lies in western Dun Morogh, just north of Brewnall Village. Bitter cold keeps thick sheets of ice creeping across its surface, so local residents such as Paxton Ganter clear holes for fishing and drinking water. The shore offers sustenance, but the islands in the lake’s center are dangerous ground. A fierce pack of wild wolves prowls those icy mounds, led by Timber, a savage gray worg.
